title: Structural and functional perspectives on DEAD-box RNA helicases in the rubber tree cold stress response.
authors: Gao, Baocai; Xiao, Mingxia; Mao, Changli; Liu, Jin
one_liner_zh: 该综述结合AlphaFold2结构预测与冷胁迫多组学数据，分析橡胶树DEAD-box RNA解旋酶的结构与功能，虽以非模式植物蛋白为对象，但展示了计算结构预测在蛋白结构功能研究中的可迁移应用，对蛋白质结构计算课题有参考价值。
abstract: DExD/H-box RNA helicases constitute one of the largest families of adenosine triphosphate (ATP)-dependent nucleic-acid enzymes, with roles spanning the full breadth of RNA metabolism, from transcription to turnover. Their defining architectural feature is a conserved helicase core comprising two tandem RecA-like domains that couples ATP hydrolysis to duplex unwinding and ribonucleoprotein remodeling. Structural investigations have historically focused on human and yeast model systems, but recent methodological advances, particularly cryo-electron microscopy and deep learning-based structure prediction, have broadened the structural coverage of the DDX family, including full-length constructs and their incorporation into multiprotein assemblies. In plants, DDX helicases remain far less characterized despite their essential functions in development and stress adaptation. This review integrates structural biology insights with recent multi-omics datasets from cold-stressed rubber tree (Hevea brasiliensis), a tropical crop highly susceptible to chilling injury. Quantitative profiling has identified nine differentially abundant DDX proteins under cold stress, among which DDX39B shows the most pronounced response. Rubber tree DDX39B shares >95% sequence identity with orthologs from other tropical species and ~73% identity with human DDX39B; AlphaFold2 predictions reveal near-identical core helicase folds, consistent with strong functional constraint across vast evolutionary distances. These predictions also reveal plant-specific domain arrangements, including a putative DDX39B isoform bearing additional LysM and protein kinase domains. This work illustrates how computational structure prediction can bridge the sequence-to-function gap for stress-responsive proteins in non-model plant species and provides a conceptual framework for dissecting DDX helicase roles in plant abiotic stress tolerance.
abstract_zh: DExD/H-box RNA解旋酶构成腺苷三磷酸（ATP）依赖性核酸酶中最大的家族之一，其作用涵盖RNA代谢的整个范围，从转录到降解。其定义性结构特征是保守的解旋酶核心，包含两个串联的RecA样结构域，将ATP水解与双链解旋及核糖核蛋白重塑偶联起来。结构研究历来集中于人类和酵母模型系统，但近期方法学进展，特别是冷冻电子显微镜和基于深度学习的结构预测，拓宽了DDX家族的结构覆盖范围，包括全长构建体及其在多蛋白复合物中的整合。在植物中，DDX解旋酶尽管在发育和胁迫适应中具有关键功能，但其表征仍远不充分。本综述将结构生物学见解与来自冷胁迫橡胶树（Hevea brasiliensis）的近期多组学数据集相结合，该热带作物对冷害高度敏感。定量分析已鉴定出冷胁迫下九个差异丰度的DDX蛋白，其中DDX39B表现出最显著的反应。橡胶树DDX39B与其他热带物种的直系同源物共享>95%的序列同一性，与人类DDX39B共享约73%的同一性；AlphaFold2预测揭示近乎相同的核心解旋酶折叠，与跨越巨大进化距离的强功能约束一致。这些预测还揭示了植物特异性结构域排列，包括一个带有额外LysM和蛋白激酶结构域的推定DDX39B异构体。本工作展示了计算结构预测如何弥合非模式植物物种中胁迫响应蛋白的序列到功能差距，并为解析DDX解旋酶在植物非生物胁迫耐受性中的作用提供了概念框架。
